skills.name: bcms
skills.description: BCMS headless CMS for coding agents. Build with the @thebcms/client SDK (templates, entries, groups, widgets, media, functions, webhooks, API keys, permissions) and operate content through the BCMS Model Context Protocol (MCP) server—scoped keys, Streamable HTTP, entry/media tools. Use for content modeling, framework integrations (Next.js, Nuxt, Astro, Svelte, Gatsby, Vite), and agent-driven content operations.

skills.name: bcms-content
skills.description: Run BCMS content operations from the command line. A thin CLI (wrapping the official @thebcms/client SDK) for agents to create, update, delete, and list entries and upload media using a single API key — the same three-part key used for the BCMS MCP. Use this for scripted, deterministic content tasks in terminals, CI, and agent workflows.

clients.name: Cursor
clients.notes: Plugin bundle in providers/cursor/plugin with a marketplace manifest in this repository; not listed in the public Cursor marketplace directory. Skills also install via skills.sh.

clients.name: Claude Code
clients.notes: Plugin bundle in providers/claude/plugin installable via claude plugin marketplace add bcms/ai; not listed in a public Claude marketplace directory. Skills also install via skills.sh.

clients.name: Codex
clients.notes: No dedicated package. Skills install via the skills.sh CLI into agent skill folders that Codex reads; MCP connects over Streamable HTTP. Not tested by maintainers.

clients.name: ChatGPT
clients.notes: No package, connector, or documented install path.

clients.name: OpenClaw
clients.notes: Both skills are published on ClawHub and install with openclaw skills install @bcms/<skill>.

clients.name: ClawHub (registry)
clients.notes: Registry listing for OpenClaw installs: https://clawhub.ai/bcms/bcms and https://clawhub.ai/bcms/bcms-content.

clients.name: skills.sh (registry)
clients.notes: Registry listing: https://www.skills.sh/bcms/ai/bcms and https://www.skills.sh/bcms/ai/bcms-content. Installs run from this GitHub repository.

plugins.name: bcms
plugins.installMethod: Add this repository as a Cursor plugin marketplace (manifest at .cursor-plugin/marketplace.json), then install the "bcms" plugin.

plugins.name: bcms
plugins.installMethod: claude plugin marketplace add bcms/ai, then claude plugin install bcms.

mcp.authentication: mcpKey query parameter — a three-part BCMS API key (keyId.secret.instanceId) with the MCP flag enabled; the endpoint returns 403 otherwise. Send the mcp-session-id header on follow-up requests after initialize.

clientNotes.cursor: Add a url entry to mcp.json (see providers/cursor/plugin/mcp.json.example).
clientNotes.other: Any client that supports Streamable HTTP MCP servers can connect with the endpoint template above.

cli.name: bcms-content-cli
cli.installMethod: npx skills add bcms/ai --skill bcms-content, then npm install inside the installed skill folder. Not published to npm.

commands.name: create-entry
commands.summary: Create an entry in a template (by id or name).
commands.retryNote: Retrying after an ambiguous failure can create duplicate entries — list entries first.

commands.name: update-entry
commands.summary: Update an entry; returns the full parsed entry after the update.
commands.retryNote: Safe to retry: the same payload produces the same result.

commands.name: delete-entry
commands.summary: Delete an entry (irreversible). Requires confirmation or --yes.
commands.retryNote: Safe to retry: a repeated delete fails with NOT_FOUND, nothing else changes.

commands.name: list-entries
commands.summary: List entry ids for a template (discovery before update/delete).

commands.name: upload-media
commands.summary: Upload a file to the media library.
commands.retryNote: Retrying after an ambiguous failure can create duplicate media files.
